scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck:worker && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:compiler-wasm && npm run build:lsp-wasm
scripts.build:compiler-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --profile wasm-release && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-reference-types --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int ../crates/wasm/pkg/solcore_wasm_bg.wasm -o ../crates/wasm/pkg/solcore_wasm_bg.wasm
scripts.build:lsp-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/lsp --target web --out-dir pkg --profile wasm-release -- --features wasm && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-reference-types --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int ../crates/lsp/pkg/solcore_lsp_bg.wasm -o ../crates/lsp/pkg/solcore_lsp_bg.wasm
